signal: Sage Health raised a $65M Series C plus a $50M debt facility (early 2026) to expand its Medicare-focused primary care into new markets

email.body1:
Bryant, saw Sage raised its $65M Series C and a $50M facility to expand into new underserved markets.

Growth that fast usually means more accounts and partners in play than the team can cover before the new markets staff up, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Sage off your hiring and growth signals, accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Bryant, quick follow-up for Sage.

With new markets opening, pipeline and partnership targets climb faster than headcount can keep up. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Sage needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Bryant, last bit of proof for Sage.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire reps fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Sage's reply rate likely compares to similar growth-stage teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Bryant, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and a multi-market expansion is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Sage either way.
